title: Work gallery
description: One object per project, in scroll order. Images: files in public/assets/projects/ or a full URL.

id.description: Optional slug (used for filenames). Auto-generated from title if omitted.

title.description: Project name in the list and image alt text.

category.description: Subtitle under the title in the list.

description.description: Shown under the active project in the list.

image.description: Filename in public/assets/projects/ (e.g. hero.webp) or path/URL starting with / or http.

launch.description: Launch date line in the left meta column.

role.description: Role bullets. Omit for default design-direction lines.

recognition.description: Award lines. Omit for defaults. Use [] to hide the Recognition block.

url.description: Optional live project link (View site in meta while active).
